module s_fix
(
	input clk,
	
	input sync_in,
	output sync_out
);

assign sync_out = sync_in ^ pol;

reg pol;
always @(posedge clk) begin
	integer pos = 0, neg = 0, cnt = 0;
	reg s1,s2;

	s1 <= sync_in;
	s2 <= s1;

	if(~s2 & s1) neg <= cnt;
	if(s2 & ~s1) pos <= cnt;

	cnt <= cnt + 1;
	if(s2 != s1) cnt <= 0;

	pol <= pos > neg;
end

endmodule
